idea: Orbit unions of H(8) under cyclic and commuting-pair groups of Q-isometries (GF(8) port of round-4 c3). Best: cyclic group <h>, h = g^91 of order 5, g a product of 7 orthogonal transvections (|g| = 455): 5833 good orbits, tabu max-weight clique = 217 (43 orbits of size 5 + 2 fixed points). Commuting pairs (a in a nondegenerate U of dim 2 or 4, b in U-perp): 84 groups, best 217. Greedy fill adds 0 points. 90 s tabu replay of the order-5 graph and 120 s povoid_ils2 from the 217 set: no gain.
code: research/squads/d13D7_r5/c1/orb8.py (GF(8) library, port of research/squads/d13D7_r4/c3/orbq.py), run8.py (driver), replay8.py (longer clique / warm start), finish8.py (greedy fill), wclq2.c (copy of r3 c3)
command: python3 research/squads/d13D7_r5/c1/run8.py --mode cyc --seed 1 --cpu 90 --dmin 5 --dmax 600 --kmax 8000 --texact 2 --theur 0.3 ; python3 research/squads/d13D7_r5/c1/run8.py --mode pair --seed 2 --cpu 280 --dmin 5 --dmax 600 --kmax 8000 --texact 2 --theur 0.3 --pairk 2,4 --perk 4 ; python3 research/squads/d13D7_r5/c1/finish8.py research/squads/d13D7_r5/c1/best_raw_idx.txt research/squads/d13D7_r5/c1/filled217_idx.txt ; research/d13D7/tools/oppcheck research/d13D7/hex/hex_q8.bin P research/squads/d13D7_r5/c1/best_idx.txt
next: 217 is a plateau: five different groups (cyclic order 5, commuting pairs of orders 6, 9, 12) all reach 217 under tabu, and the full-graph ILS does not move it. Next: exact or stronger clique on the order-3 (K ~ 12000) and order-7 graphs, groups normalising the Singer-type tori (orders 511, 513, 73), and non-abelian groups generated by two transvection products.

idea: orbit cliques of <alpha,phi> (alpha = delta^2 from the explicit duality, order 6; phi = Frobenius, involution; both verified collineations) by wclq2 (3958); then point-level ILS seeded from that set (3967). Warm-started <alpha> orbit clique gave 3964 (not better).
